UZDoomDroid: an unofficial, controller-only Android port of UZDoom.

THIS IS A MODIFIED VERSION OF UZDOOM. The Android port was written by an AI (Anthropic's Claude) and is not made, reviewed, endorsed or supported by the UZDoom team. Do not report problems with it to UZDoom.

Modification notice (GNU GPL v3, section 5a): modified from UZDoom commit 678ed12027fec6257a08bfcdbabba06bfcebf8de, starting 2026-11-22. The changes add Android support. The repository README lists them, and the commit history has the full record.

Source code (complete and corresponding, including the build scripts):

The game-content files (brightmaps.pk3, game_support.pk3, game_widescreen_gfx.pk3) are based on original game content. They may be shared freely but may not be sold. See their entries in this list.

No game data is included. You need your own copy of the game files.

Third-party libraries, used unmodified:
• SDL 2.32.8 (zlib license): https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL
• OpenAL Soft 1.24.3 (GNU LGPL), shipped as libopenal.so, which you may replace: https://github.com/kcat/openal-soft
• GCEM (Apache License 2.0): https://github.com/kthohr/gcem
